findings.text: The diff marks existing pictures as deleted: `ext/drawer/rail/shots/files.jsonl`, `ext/drawer/walkthrough/shots/files.jsonl` and `ux/Dictate/playground/walkthrough/shots/files.jsonl` gain `"gone":true` lines for every png, and those pngs still exist in the main tree (`ext/drawer/rail/shots/rail-400.png` and the rest). They exist only because the worktree has no pngs, so merging this would hide real shots on the site. Drop those three files from the commit. The unrelated index lines in `ux/files.jsonl` (`Browse/page.js`), `ux/Inbox/files.jsonl` (`doc/`), `ux/Dictate/files.jsonl` (`inbox.jsonl`) and `core/Page/ext/Inbox/files.jsonl` are also outside the fence and should go too.

The fast gate `FAST_NAMED = /fast/i` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:62) matches "fast" anywhere, so "Smart assistant, where is the fast assistant's prompt?" (replay sentence 3) and "breakfast" both count as naming the fast assistant. The replay's 0 of 8 for that sentence comes from the prompt, not the code gate. Anchoring the match to the address (`/^\W*fast\b/i`, or at least `\bfast\b`) would make the code gate do what the ask says.

Ask 2 is only partly met, and next.md says so honestly: context fell 35 percent (68k to 44k, not half), and the cold first reply fell to 6.8 s against a target of 6 s (replay-step2a.json; replay-step2b.json gives 7.4 s). The 46.2 s baseline in replay-step1.json is far above the 11.4 s desktop figure next.md recorded before, so the "before" number looks noisy; a second baseline run would make the comparison trustworthy.

`setting_sources: []` (Sessions.js:1051) also removes CLAUDE.md and the skills from the smart assistant, so the brief in `session-smart.md` is now the only rule it follows. That is fine if the brief is self-contained, but the change should be recorded in session-smart's doc as a deliberate trade, so nobody later "fixes" it by adding a skill the agent can no longer load.

With a real 60dvh height, the sheet no longer shrinks to fit short content. `ext/drawer/doc/rail-notes.md` c35 still says "the sheet grows with its content, up to half the screen", so it is now stale. The comment at rail.js:247 replaced its pointer, but the doc entry needs a line too.

The Inbox.js fix (lines 51-54) costs one extra `files.jsonl` fetch of the parent folder on each open where the page is not already live. If a page writes `page.jsonl` before its parent's file list is refreshed, its notes are skipped. That is acceptable for removing a console 404, but worth one line in the Inbox doc.

Ask 6 is not all done: no `check_page` results at 400/1200/1920/3440, no card, and no landing line appear in the diff, and the 400 before/after shots are not committed (next.md says so). Whoever lands this still has to do those steps.
